name: Zen Context Menu (Lean)
description: Lean fork of Zen Context Menu: pure option hiding (display:none) — no styling, fully compatible with Context Menu Icons (CMI)
author: KiKaraage (fork: Impre)

pinned-url.uc.js.name: Pinned URL Extractor
pinned-url.uc.js.description: Extracts 'Replace pinned URL with current' from the 'Edit pinned URL' submenu to top level (short label 'Remplacer l'URL', pinned tabs only) and hides the gutted submenu. Re-asserted on popupshown — Zen's popupshowing handlers undo earlier DOM edits

cmi-buttons.uc.js.name: CMI Buttons Tagger
cmi-buttons.uc.js.description: On popupshowing, counts visible CMI action buttons and tags #tabContextMenu with ucbtns='3|4' so CSS can pick the right centered margin layout (works around Gecko freezing :has() on hidden toggles during popupshowing)
